messages:
sre_bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT alert - production canary cluster latency regressions detected after the 1792123000 deploy. Threshold breach: p95 latency > 1200ms on text-gen route. Auto-paging to #incidents.

emma_oncall: I’m on it. joining call in 2. Any immediate customer-facing impact?

ben_customer_ops: Seeing 5 support tickets from two customers (acme-corp, healthlytics) complaining about timeouts in doc-summarize flow. Not widespread, but important for SLAs.

raj_runtime: Observing kernel fallback logs on several canary pods. Root cause looks like new batching changes pushing memory usage -> OOM-triggered fallback to slow kernel path. Repro: high-concurrency + long context.

olivia_prod: @emma_oncall please confirm whether we can flip the feature-flag for the new batching algorithm. There's a kill-switch in config service.

emma_oncall: Pulling kill-switch now. Calling out steps in case rollback needed.

emma_oncall: RUNNING now: 
```
# flip kill-switch via admin API
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://config.redwood-inference.internal/api/v1/flags/batching_v2/disable
```

emma_oncall: Flag flip submitted, waiting for propagation (30s).

devops_bot: Feature-flag update event received. Propagation to canary region completed.

raj_runtime: Confirming metrics: p95 dropped from ~1300ms to ~420ms over the last 60s after flag flip. Kernel fallback logs decreasing. Memory used on canary nodes trending down.

ben_customer_ops: Reopened one ticket and updated customers: "We've rolled back a recent batching change and are monitoring; ETA 10-15m". They acknowledged.

emma_oncall: Good. However load test shows a handful of canary pods still intermittently falling back to fallback-kernel under synthetic stress. I'm going to trigger a canary rollback of the release to be safe. Rolling back via deploy bot.

emma_oncall: /deploy rollback --release 1792123000 --canary-only

devops_bot: Deploy rollback started for release 1792123000 (canary). Step 1/3: stop new pods. Step 2/3: start previous release image.

raj_runtime: While rollback proceeds, I'm going to disable continuous-batching on runtime node config to avoid queue buildup which exacerbates fallback. Small config tweak: set batching.max_batch_size=32, batching.max_wait_ms=20.

emma_oncall: Apply command snippet: 
```
# kubectl patch configmap runtime-config -n canary --type merge -p '{"data":{"batching.max_batch_size":"32","batching.max_wait_ms":"20"}}'
```

raj_runtime: Patch applied. Observability: queue depth back to normal, no more OOM events in logs.

devops_bot: Rollback to previous image completed on 6/6 canary pods. Health checks passing.

olivia_prod: Assigning post-incident ticket to runtime and release engineering to do root-cause analysis and tighten canary criteria. Jordan, can you own customer comms follow-up?

jordan_pm: Yep, I'll draft a note and coordinate with Ben for affected customers. We'll include mitigation and next steps.

emma_oncall: Handoff: I'm going to run a diagnostic sweep for 15m, then hand to @olivia_prod for overnight monitoring. Current status: mitigation successful, rollback completed, customer impact limited and acknowledged.

olivia_prod: Taking over monitoring. Please leave notes in the incident doc: link to logs, commands, and timeline.

raj_runtime: Quick log snippets for RCA: 
```
# observed stack traces
2028-07-21T14:12:03Z runtime ERROR kv_cache: eviction triggered, mem_used=89% -> kernel_fallback
2028-07-21T14:12:04Z runtime WARN batching: queue_depth=120, max_batch_size=256, wait_ms=200
```

raj_runtime: Hypothesis: new batching_v2 increases max_batch_size and wait_ms for throughput improvements; under certain concurrency patterns this pushes memory pressure which trips kernel safety fallback. Fallback path currently ~3-4x slower.

emma_oncall: Next actions (assigned):
- raj_runtime: run targeted load tests to reproduce and tune batching parameters, consider adaptive limits.
- eng-runtime: add guardrails to disable batching_v2 automatically when mem > 80% on canary.
- release_eng: review deploy gating to include memory/fallback smoke checks in canary.
- jordan_pm + ben_customer_ops: follow up comms.

ben_customer_ops: I'll keep open tickets updated and close once customers confirm stable.

devops_bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2. Time to mitigation: ~9 minutes from page.

emma_oncall: Closing thread for active mitigation, keeping incident doc open for RCA write-up. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

olivia_prod: Acknowledged. Taking 1hr monitoring shift now.
